purpose: Closed contract for locale profiles, the locale directive, locale selection, localized word recognition and source mapping in LCL 0.3.0. A locale profile is data, not code; it changes only which source spellings denote canonical reserved words.

profile_document.encoding: UTF-8 without byte-order mark, one JSON object (RFC 8259). Duplicate object keys, other top-level fields, and non-string keys are invalid.

fields.lcl_version: Exact string 0.3.0. Any other value is error.localization.profile_invalid (incompatible version).
fields.locale: One locale tag well formed under locale_tag, written in its normalized form.
fields.repertoires: Non-empty array of distinct lexical_repertoires identifiers in ascending order.
fields.spellings: Non-empty object mapping each localized source spelling to exactly one canonical reserved word classified localized_lexeme in localization_surface_v0.3.0.json.
fields.preferred: Object mapping canonical reserved words to their preferred spelling for rendering and completion. Every key is a value of spellings and every value is a spelling that maps to that key.
fields.coverage: Object with mapped_reserved_words (INTEGER equal to the number of distinct values of spellings) and complete (BOOLEAN, TRUE exactly when every localized_lexeme is mapped).
fields.provenance: Object with provider_class (one of provider_classes) and provider_identity (non-empty ASCII string naming the provider product or fixture, never a credential, token, key, or personal data).

optional_fields.display_labels: Object mapping registered identifiers from localized_preferred_display_only domains to display labels. Labels are presentation only and never accepted as source.

content_identity.input: The exact profile bytes that were validated.
content_identity.form: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
content_identity.rule: Identity is computed before parsing and bound to the parsed result. Any byte change, including reformatting, is a different profile. An evaluation records the identity of the profile it used.

locale_tag.normalization: Comparison is ASCII case-insensitive. The normalized form writes language in lowercase, script with an uppercase first letter and lowercase rest, and region in uppercase.
locale_tag.invalid: Any other subtag, extension, private-use or grandfathered form, empty subtag, LOW LINE separator, or non-ASCII character is error.localization.locale_invalid.

lexical_repertoires.word_continuation: After its first scalar a word may also contain ASCII digits U+0030..U+0039 and LOW LINE U+005F.
lexical_repertoires.authoring_provenance: Letter ranges were computed from Unicode 16.0.0 General_Category Lu (latin, cyrillic) and Lo (cjk_unified); the ranges above are normative data and no host Unicode database is consulted.

spelling_rules: A spelling has 1 to 64 Unicode scalar values.
Its first scalar is a letter of one repertoire listed by the profile, and every later letter belongs to that same repertoire; later scalars may also be word_continuation scalars.
It contains no ASCII lowercase letter, combining mark, control, format character, space, or symbol.
It does not match SIMPLE_IDENTIFIER or QUALIFIED_IDENTIFIER.
If it equals a canonical reserved word, it maps to that same reserved word.
It maps to exactly one reserved word; a reserved word may have several spellings.
No two distinct spellings of a profile have the same confusable skeleton.
No spelling has the confusable skeleton of a canonical reserved word other than the reserved word it maps to.

matching.normalization: None. A source word matches a spelling only by exact Unicode scalar sequence equality. Source bytes are never normalized, case-folded, or rewritten.
matching.case: Exact. No case folding is applied to localized words.
matching.host_independence: Recognition uses only the ranges and tables of this registry and never a locale-sensitive or host-provided Unicode function.

confusable_skeleton.rule: The skeleton of a word replaces every scalar that is a key of map by its value and leaves every other scalar unchanged.

locale_directive.form: @locale, one SPACE, one locale tag, LINE FEED.
locale_directive.placement: Only as the first line, beginning at byte offset zero. Any other line beginning with @locale, a second directive, or a malformed directive is error.localization.directive_invalid.
locale_directive.classification: LOCALE_DIRECTIVE is a canonical_invariant structural source class and is not an AST node, token, statement, or execution input.
locale_directive.source_effect: The directive line is excluded from the canonical token stream. Every later token keeps its original byte offsets.

source_words.candidate_word: Outside STRING and MULTILINE_STRING literals and the locale directive, a word is a maximal run of ASCII letters, ASCII digits, LOW LINE, and letters of any registered repertoire. A word is a candidate word when its first scalar is an ASCII uppercase letter or a repertoire letter and it contains no ASCII lowercase letter. Every other word, including SIMPLE_IDENTIFIER and QUALIFIED_IDENTIFIER segments, keeps the LCL 0.1.0 identifier and keyword-case rules.
source_words.non_canonical_word: A candidate word that is not a canonical reserved word.
source_words.canonical_document: Without a directive, pinned selection, or non_canonical_word, the document is interpreted with canonical reserved words exactly as in LCL 0.1.0 lexical rules and no profile is selected.
under_selected_profile: A candidate word that is a spelling of the selected profile is the canonical reserved word it maps to.
Otherwise a canonical reserved word is error.localization.mixed.
Otherwise a word that mixes repertoires, or whose confusable skeleton equals the skeleton of a spelling of the selected profile, is error.localization.confusable.
source_words.non_ascii_outside_string: Any other non-ASCII scalar outside a string literal remains error.source.non_ascii_outside_string. All other LCL 0.1.0 source-text rules, including UTF-8 validity, byte-order mark, LINE FEED, TAB, control character, trailing SPACE, and final LINE FEED rules, are unchanged.

selection.explicit: A valid directive selects its locale. No detector result is consulted. If a pin for the document names a different locale or profile identity, the result is error.localization.profile_drift.
selection.pinned: Without a directive, a project or cache pin selects its recorded locale and requires a resolved profile with exactly the recorded content identity; otherwise error.localization.profile_drift, or error.localization.profile_unavailable when no profile is obtained.
selection.auto: Without a directive or pin and with at least one non_canonical_word, a detector proposes candidate locales and the resolver supplies profiles for them. After validation, the profiles that spell at least one non_canonical_word are matches. Exactly one match is selected. More than one match is error.localization.detection_ambiguous. No match is error.localization.detection_failed, or error.localization.profile_unavailable when no detector or resolver is available.
selection.canonical: Without a directive, pin, or non_canonical_word, no profile is selected.
selection.failure: Every localization-stage error stops the source unit before lexical interpretation of words, grammar, AST construction, resolution, and execution.

fields.locale: normalized locale tag, absent for canonical
fields.profile_identity: content identity of the selected profile, absent for canonical
fields.detector_identity: identity of the detector whose proposal was used, present for auto
fields.candidate_locales: normalized tags proposed by the detector in its order, present for auto

selection_record.rule: The record is presentation and reproducibility metadata. It never changes canonical tokens, grammar, semantics, diagnostics identifiers, or results.

provider_contract.detector: A provider-neutral function from candidate words and available locales to an ordered list of candidate locale tags with a detector identity. It performs no parsing and cannot select a profile by itself.
provider_contract.resolver: A provider-neutral function from one normalized locale tag to profile bytes and a provider class, or unavailability. It is not consulted when an explicit or pinned selection already has the exact pinned bytes.
provider_contract.trust: Detector and resolver output is untrusted until the returned profile validates under this schema. Invalid output is error.localization.profile_invalid and is never partially used.
provider_contract.pinning: A project or cache pin binds a document to a locale and profile identity. Later resolver output with another identity never replaces it silently.
provider_contract.no_network_requirement: A conforming implementation needs no network access, credentials, or vendor service; fixture, cache, and project profiles are sufficient.

source_map.rule: Every token, diagnostic, and AST span refers to byte offsets of the original localized source. A localized token carries its canonical reserved word as its identity. No canonical-spelling rendering of the source is produced, persisted, or used for locations.
source_map.persistence: Saving a document writes the author's bytes. Localization never rewrites the file.
